thread:
Liam: FYI we received invoice INV-5503 from CloudConnect billed to Redwood EU entity with 20% VAT applied. Vendor attached an EU VAT ID but country prefix doesn't match (GB vs NL). Invoice total EUR 12,000, VAT EUR 2,400. PDF: https://invoices.example.com/INV-5503.pdf

Anya: Oof. If VAT ID country code mismatch we cant treat it as valid for reverse charge. Need vendor to correct VAT ID and reissue invoice (no VAT) or provide proof of VAT registration in Netherlands.

Priya: AP: hold payment until vendor reissues. Also confirm if our EU entity is the billed party (it is) and whether intra-community supply rules apply.

Sam: Quick check: vendor name matches vendor master? Is the billing address NL or UK? If vendor moved from GB post-Brexit they should have NL VAT ID with NL prefix. Could be a typo.

Liam: Vendor message: "Sorry, pasted old VAT number. We'll reissue net invoice with NL-987654321 by EOD." They also attached a screenshot of national VAT cert.

Anya: Good. For audit keep original PDF + vendor note + reissued invoice. If they insist on VAT charged, we may need to file for VAT refund in vendor country or claim input VAT in local return. Simpler: vendor reissue net.

tax-bot: Event: invoice_validation status=vat_id_mismatch (vendor_id=CC-311)

Priya: AP has placed hold. When reissue arrives, tag @Sam to update vendor master and @Anya for tax filing notes. Also update Coupa record with corrected VAT ID.

Sam: Reminder: update vendor onboarding checklist: require country-prefix-validated VAT ID for EU vendors and add a quick regex check in Coupa. Small automation will cut these noise tickets down.

Liam: Closing: I'll follow up with vendor in 2 hours. If no reissue, AP to request credit memo referencing original invoice. Thanks. :thumbsup:
